html:
What if something as simple as a dental checkup could change the way someone smiles — and the way they feel about themselves?

At Sewashram Wardha, this became a reality on 13th April 2024, when Lata Agrawal Foundation organized a free dental camp for children and young adults.

For many, this wasn’t just another health visit. It was their first time receiving proper dental care. Some came in quietly, unsure of what to expect. Others carried the discomfort they had learned to live with.

But as the day unfolded, something changed. Fear turned into ease. Uncertainty turned into trust. And most importantly, hesitant expressions turned into genuine smiles.

Because this initiative was never just about dental care.It was about dignity, care, and being seen. It was about reminding every individual that their health matters, their smile matters, and they matter.

Sometimes, the smallest acts of care can leave the biggest impact — and in this case, it started with a smile.

Credits: Story written by Pauline Muhuyi based on Lata Agrawal Foundation’s work

html:
Free Eye Checkup at Sewashram

  • Date: 14th December 2024
  • Time: 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM
  • Participants:
    • 65 children
    • 35 elderly individuals

Purpose:

  • Checked elderly individuals for cataracts.
  • Conducted vision tests for children to assess refractive errors.

Outcome:

  • The camp was a success, with everyone participating enthusiastically.

We sincerely thank Mr. Shivaji Choudhary, the owner of Sewashram, for providing us the opportunity to contribute to the well-being of the residents.
